query: Hi Pupper, what is your purpose?
Pupper, give me an overview of your abilities. You can take up to a minute to respond.
Ok, Pupper, tell me your tools and scripts. List them for me.
Ok pupper. Give me a list of all the scripts you handle.
Ok, how do I log out here?
Ok Pupper, I would like you to run the end of day scripts to log us out.
